Fitting in and functioning normally in the world around me
Not harming others through my actions

questions.question: When you realize you are doing something harmful to others, you:

options.text: Try not to think about it too much
Remind yourself that no one is perfect
Feel an inner conflict and keep coming back to it
Look for how to change it

questions.question: When you encounter a truth that would require changing your relationship with your surroundings, you:

options.text: Do not risk changes in relationships, no matter what the truth is
Prefer to avoid going into it at all
Admit it to yourself, even if you do not talk about it with others
Believe it is important to face it, even if it is uncomfortable

questions2.question: How do you define your character?

options.text: I am who I am and I don't need to change
I am mostly good, with some flaws
I try to be compassionate and do the right thing
I want to align my actions with my values

questions2.question: When you learn something uncomfortable about yourself, you:

options.text: Ignore it and continue as before
Admit it, but make excuses
Feel conflicted and unsure what to do
Reflect deeply and consider change
My comfort and convenience
Following social norms and fitting in
Being a good person in my own way
Living in alignment with my deepest values
